title: Account lockout after failed sign-in attempts - case 1
symptoms: Password reset does not restore access
steps_taken: Checked lockout status in identity console
root_cause: Repeated failed password attempts triggered lockout policy
resolution: Unlocked the account after identity verification and asked the user to reset saved passwords.

title: API key rotation required for service integration - case 1
root_cause: Old API key expired or was revoked
resolution: Stored the new key in secrets manager, redeployed the service, and revoked the old key.

title: AWS role assumption denied - case 1
root_cause: User was missing required AWS permission set
resolution: Added the approved permission set and confirmed the user could assume the role.

title: Login loop caused by stale browser session - case 1
root_cause: Stale browser cookie caused invalid session handling
resolution: Cleared cached site data and confirmed normal login in the primary browser.

title: CI pipeline failed on pull request - case 1
symptoms: Build passes locally but fails in CI
root_cause: Dependency lockfile was not updated with package change
resolution: Updated the lockfile and reran CI successfully.

title: Cloud budget alert triggered - case 1
root_cause: Non-production compute resources were left running overnight
resolution: Stopped unused resources and notified the owning team to add scheduled shutdown.

title: Container image pull failure - case 1
root_cause: Deployment referenced an image tag that was not pushed
resolution: Pushed the expected image tag and restarted the rollout.

title: Database connection timeout - case 1
root_cause: Firewall rule did not allow the service subnet
resolution: Added the approved firewall rule and confirmed successful connection tests.

title: Device not compliant for application access - case 1
root_cause: Management profile was missing from the laptop
resolution: Reinstalled the management profile and confirmed compliance status passed.

title: Internal hostname does not resolve - case 1
root_cause: DNS record was missing in the internal zone
resolution: Created the internal DNS record and verified resolution from VPN and office networks.

title: Business email quarantined - case 1
symptoms: User did not receive expected email
root_cause: Sender domain failed authentication checks
resolution: Released the safe message and asked the sender to correct SPF/DKIM configuration.

title: Ticket missing escalation details - case 1
root_cause: Ticket lacked reproduction steps and impact statement
resolution: Updated ticket details and reassigned it to the correct escalation group.

title: GitHub repository access denied - case 1
root_cause: User was not added to the repository team
resolution: Added user to the approved GitHub team and confirmed repository access.

title: Kubernetes pod in CrashLoopBackOff - case 1
root_cause: Required environment variable was missing from deployment config
resolution: Added the missing variable and restarted the deployment.

title: Laptop low disk space blocks update - case 1
root_cause: Build cache and downloads consumed available storage
resolution: Cleared cache directories and confirmed the system update completed.

title: Product license not assigned - case 1
root_cause: User was not assigned to the product license group
resolution: Assigned the correct license and asked the user to sign out and sign in again.

title: Production logging dashboard access denied - case 1
symptoms: Staging logs are visible but production logs are not
root_cause: Production log access group was missing
resolution: Added approved logging group membership and confirmed dashboard access after propagation.

title: MFA reset needed after phone replacement - case 1
root_cause: Old phone was still registered as the only MFA method
resolution: Reset MFA registration and confirmed the user could sign in with the new device.

title: Noisy alert repeatedly pages on-call - case 1
root_cause: Alert threshold was too sensitive for normal traffic variation
resolution: Updated threshold and added owner labels and runbook link.

title: Firewall rule required for service dependency - case 1
symptoms: Access works from one environment only
root_cause: No firewall rule allowed traffic from staging subnet
resolution: Created approved firewall rule with expiration and confirmed connectivity.

title: Application tile missing in Okta - case 1
root_cause: Automated group rule had not applied to the user
resolution: Manually synced group membership and confirmed the application tile appeared.

title: Password reset token expired - case 1
root_cause: User opened an expired password reset token
resolution: Issued a new reset link and confirmed successful password change.

title: Office printer unavailable - case 1
root_cause: Approved printer profile was missing from the device
resolution: Installed printer profile and confirmed a test page printed.

title: Production deployment rollback after elevated errors - case 1
steps_taken: Compared metrics before and after release
root_cause: New release introduced incompatible configuration
resolution: Rolled back to the previous stable version and monitored service recovery.

title: Remote desktop connection refused - case 1
root_cause: User was missing remote desktop access group membership
resolution: Added approved group membership and confirmed remote desktop login.

title: Salesforce insufficient privileges - case 1
root_cause: Required permission set was not assigned
resolution: Assigned the approved permission set and confirmed object visibility.

title: Secrets manager read access denied - case 1
root_cause: Service account did not have read permission for the secret
resolution: Added least-privilege secret read policy and redeployed the workload.

title: Possible credential exposure reported - case 1
root_cause: Credential was accidentally included in a code commit
resolution: Revoked the credential, rotated replacement secret, and opened a security incident record.

title: Service account permission denied - case 1
symptoms: Batch job fails with permission denied
root_cause: Production role binding was missing for the service account
resolution: Added the approved least-privilege role binding and reran the job.

title: Shared drive access request - case 1
symptoms: User can view but not edit
root_cause: User had viewer access but needed editor access
resolution: Granted approved editor role and confirmed the user could update the document.

title: Slack private channel access missing - case 1
root_cause: Channel owner approval had not been completed
resolution: Owner approved access and the user was invited to the private channel.

title: Software install blocked by endpoint policy - case 1
root_cause: Requested software was not yet approved for managed devices
resolution: Submitted security review and provided approved alternative software.

title: SSO login fails with SAML error - case 1
root_cause: Application assignment was missing required SAML attribute
resolution: Updated app assignment attributes and confirmed SSO login succeeded.

title: VPN connection fails after MFA prompt - case 1
root_cause: VPN profile was outdated after gateway migration
resolution: Reinstalled the current VPN profile and confirmed internal site access.

title: VPN setup needed for new laptop - case 1
root_cause: New laptop had not received the VPN profile
resolution: Installed approved VPN profile and verified access to internal status page.

title: Production OAuth login failed after client secret rotation
symptoms: All users received an invalid_client error after authentication
Other SSO applications continued to work
steps_taken: Correlated identity provider and application logs
Confirmed the authorization step succeeded and token exchange failed
Compared the deployed secret reference with the active secret version
root_cause: The secret was rotated in the vault, but the production deployment still referenced the previous version.
resolution: Updated the deployment to reference the active secret version, restarted the authentication workers, and monitored login success for thirty minutes.

title: OAuth callback rejected because production redirect URI was incorrect
symptoms: Users saw redirect_uri_mismatch before the application callback
The staging environment continued to accept login
steps_taken: Captured the redirect URI from the failed request
Compared the URI with the registered production OAuth client
Verified scheme, hostname, path, and trailing slash
root_cause: A deployment generated the callback with the staging hostname while using the production client ID.
resolution: Corrected the environment callback setting, deployed the reviewed configuration, and verified fresh login and logout flows.

title: OAuth token validation failed after identity signing key rotation
symptoms: MFA succeeded but the application returned to its login page
Application logs reported an unknown token signing key identifier
steps_taken: Confirmed the identity provider issued valid tokens
Compared the token key identifier with the application key cache
Tested the identity provider key endpoint from the application network
root_cause: The application cached the previous signing key set and did not refresh it after rotation.
resolution: Refreshed the key cache, corrected its refresh interval, and confirmed token validation across all application instances.

title: Analytics pipeline delayed by schema validation retry loop
symptoms: Dashboard freshness exceeded the two-hour objective
Consumer lag grew while workers remained healthy
steps_taken: Traced an affected event through ingestion and transformation
Grouped retry errors by schema validation message
Compared the first delay with the latest source schema release
root_cause: A new optional source field was rejected by an outdated transformation schema and retried indefinitely.
resolution: Deployed the compatible schema, replayed quarantined records with idempotency checks, and reconciled source and destination counts.

title: Single hot partition caused customer event processing delay
symptoms: One tenant was six hours behind while other tenants were current
Overall worker CPU and queue depth looked normal
steps_taken: Broke consumer lag down by partition and tenant
Compared partition keys before and after a producer deployment
Measured incoming and processing rates for the affected partition
root_cause: A producer change emitted a constant partition key for one high-volume tenant.
resolution: Rolled back the producer change, restored the intended partition key, and monitored ordered catch-up for the affected tenant.

title: Pipeline backlog increased after database connection pool saturation
symptoms: Processing throughput fell below the incoming event rate
steps_taken: Located the backlog before the database write stage
Compared database calls per record across deployment versions
Checked connection pool utilization and query latency
root_cause: A transformation deployment added repeated lookup queries and saturated the existing connection pool.
resolution: Rolled back the deployment, optimized the lookup path, and verified backlog recovery and output completeness.

title: Internal API client triggered a retry storm after HTTP 429
symptoms: Client requests returned HTTP 429 during peak traffic
Request volume increased after each failed response
steps_taken: Grouped gateway traffic by client identity and endpoint
Compared request volume with the client's normal baseline
Reviewed retry timing in the latest client deployment
root_cause: The client retried immediately without respecting Retry-After, creating a synchronized retry storm.
resolution: Added bounded exponential backoff with jitter and confirmed that traffic and HTTP 429 responses returned to normal.

title: New internal API client received an incorrect shared quota
symptoms: A new client received HTTP 429 at its expected request rate
Existing clients of the same API remained healthy
steps_taken: Verified the client identity and documented quota
Compared the gateway rule with approved onboarding configuration
root_cause: The gateway assigned the new client to a low shared default quota instead of its approved client-specific quota.
resolution: Applied the approved client quota and monitored API and downstream capacity during validation.

title: Finance report job missed its run after worker queue rename
symptoms: The scheduled report had no output file
The scheduler showed the run waiting in queued state
steps_taken: Confirmed the schedule and business deadline
Compared the configured queue with active worker queues
Checked changes since the last successful run
root_cause: A worker deployment renamed its queue, but the scheduled job still targeted the previous queue name.
resolution: Updated the queue target, ran one approved recovery job, and confirmed the next scheduled trigger remained enabled.

title: Scheduled export appeared missing because of timezone configuration
symptoms: Users expected an export one hour before the configured run
Scheduler history showed no platform errors
steps_taken: Recorded the schedule expression and scheduler timezone
Compared user expectation with the UTC execution time
Verified the prior and next scheduled runs
root_cause: The schedule was configured in UTC but documented for users as local time after a daylight-saving change.
resolution: Corrected the documented delivery time and updated the approved schedule with an explicit timezone.

title: TLS warning affected one region after partial certificate rotation
symptoms: Some users received an expired certificate warning
The warning depended on the serving region
steps_taken: Recorded certificate fingerprints from each region
Checked the certificate rotation deployment status
root_cause: One regional load balancer listener still referenced the certificate from before rotation.
resolution: Deployed the approved certificate to the remaining listener and verified fingerprints and handshake errors in every region.

title: TLS clients rejected service because intermediate certificate was missing
symptoms: Older managed devices rejected the service certificate
Modern browsers reached the same hostname successfully
steps_taken: Compared the presented certificate chain across clients
Confirmed hostname and leaf certificate validity
Checked the server's configured chain bundle
root_cause: The server presented the leaf certificate without the required intermediate certificate.
resolution: Installed the approved full chain bundle and confirmed successful validation from affected device versions.
